title: Slime Friends
body:
Five Slime Friends variants and a little shop to buy them. Still WIP.

Slime model and animations: [Zero](https://fran-zerogame.itch.io/slimelab-full-color-3d-slime-asset-bundle) ([CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)), adapted for the mod. Shop computer: [Kenney](https://kenney.nl/assets/space-station-kit) (CC0).

images.alt: A blue slime sleeps in a clear specimen tube beside a price screen and red BUY button in Moon Sweepers.
